title: Changed Campfire
description: Changes campfire crafting recipe and adds some crafts
body:
This datapack changes campfires a liitle bit.

Now crafting recipe for campfire is much more simplier but they are placed unlit now.

Also now you can make charcoal from any logs and wooden tools using campfire.

You can make torch by putting stick in campfire.

You can also craft leather by putting rotten flesh in campfire.


Have fun!
